content: Haversine (sphere) vs geodesic (pyproj/Vincenty, oblate spheroid) distance differs by a small margin generally, and that margin is smallest near the equator, largest near the poles. Nigeria sits ~4-14N, close to the equator, so haversine error versus true geodesic is small in relative terms but not zero -- still meaningfully larger than sub-meter for long distances. For short settlement-to-takeoffpoint distances (sub-few-km) the practical difference between haversine and geodesic is negligible, but haversine assumes a spherical Earth (radius ~6371km) which introduces ~0.3-0.5% systematic error versus WGS84 ellipsoid regardless of latitude.
